fields.label: Pre-tax annual income ($)
fields.tooltip: Annual income can include salary, wages, packaged fringe benefits, commissions, bonuses and company superannuation contributions e.g KiwiSaver. For the self-employed it's the insured's share of the net profit (or loss) of the business, derived from their own personal exertion (after deduction of all business expenses, including depreciation), but before tax.

fields.label: We Pay Your Premiums
fields.tooltip: Waives the premiums for all the lump sum cover premiums on the policy after the chosen wait period if the insured is sick or disabled and cannot work for more than 10 hours a week after the chosen waiting period.

fields.label: Flexi Rate
fields.tooltip: Flexi-rate allows you to discount your clients premium by reducing all or part of the Advisers Initial and/or Renewal Commission.

covers.label: TI Support

fields.label: Sum Insured ($)
fields.constraint: Up to 100% of Life Cover sum insured, maximum $300,000

covers.tooltip: Pays the Terminal illness support benefit sum insured if diagnosed as terminally ill with less than 24 months to live. Apply for up to 100% Life Cover sum insured to a maximum of $300,000.

covers.label: TPD A
covers.tooltip: The large sum insured discount bands for TPD Cover are: $100,000–$249,999 / $250,000–$499,999 / $500k+

covers.label: Trauma A

fields.label: Early Trauma Benefit
fields.tooltip: Provides a partial payment for an additional 20 conditions which are less severe in nature. Pays the greater of $10,000 or 20% of the Trauma Recovery sum insured, up to a maximum of $100,000.

fields.label: Trauma Reinstatement
fields.tooltip: Allows reinstatement of Trauma Recovery Cover 12 months after a claim is made. There must be enough Life Cover to support the Trauma Recovery Cover reinstatement or Life Cover buy-back benefit should be selected.

fields.label: Continuous Trauma Benefit
fields.tooltip: Provides continuous cover even after a Trauma claim is made. Automatically reinstating the sum insured immediately after claim and allowing for up to 3 full trauma claims to be made under the policy for the same insured person.

subCoverButtons.label: Major Trauma
subCoverButtons.tooltip: This benefit provides additional cover on top of any Trauma Recovery Cover (TRC) for more severe conditions likely to require more financial support. Please note: A maximum of 300% of the TRC sum insured applied if TRC is less than $25,000.

covers.tooltip: The large sum insured discount bands for Trauma Recovery Cover are: $100,000–$249,999 / $250,000–$499,999 / $500k+

covers.label: Cancer A
covers.tooltip: Provides additional money over and above the Trauma Recovery sum insured for cancer conditions and includes the Early stage cancer benefit. The large sum insured discount bands for Cancer Cover are: $100,000–$249,999 / $250k+

covers.label: Accidental Death A
covers.tooltip: The large sum insured discount bands for Accidental Death are: $150,000–$249,999 / $250,000–$499,999 / $500,000–$999,999 / $1,000,000+

covers.label: Needlestick A
covers.tooltip: For certain occupations, provides additional financial protection against the risk of contracting hepatitis B or C or HIV.

covers.label: Specific Injury A
covers.tooltip: The Specific injury support benefit — Lump sum pays a multiple of the sum insured for specified injuries suffered as a result of an accident. It must be purchased with at least one eligible Personal Insurance cover.

optionButtons.label: Income Top-up Package
optionButtons.tooltip: Includes two benefits: Income booster — Pays an extra 33% of the monthly benefit for the first 3 months on a full claim. 25% income bonus — Pays an extra 25% of income earned when back at work part time but still on claim.

optionButtons.label: Specific Injury Support Benefit
optionButtons.tooltip: Monthly pays a multiple of the monthly benefit for specified injuries suffered as a result of an accident. While receiving payments under this benefit no additional Living or Homemaker Support benefit is payable.

optionButtons.label: Immediate Assist Package
optionButtons.tooltip: Includes two benefits: Bed-Confinement — Pays a benefit for each day the insured is confined to bed during the waiting period. Crisis Benefit — Pays a benefit upon diagnosis with one of the 11 specified conditions (including cancer, heart attack and stroke), regardless of the waiting period.

optionButtons.label: Ten-Hour Benefit
optionButtons.tooltip: Allows you to work up to 10 hours per week without affecting your Living support benefit.

optionButtons.label: Split Benefit
optionButtons.tooltip: Splits the total monthly benefit into two sums insured to allow a top-up on the base cover or different waiting periods.

optionButtons.label: Income Top-up Package
optionButtons.tooltip: Income booster — Pays an extra 33% of the monthly benefit for the first 3 months on a full claim. 25% income bonus — Pays an extra 25% of income earned when back at work part time but still on claim.

optionButtons.label: Specific Injury Support Benefit
optionButtons.tooltip: Monthly pays a multiple of the monthly benefit for specified injuries suffered as a result of an accident.

optionButtons.label: Immediate Assist Package
optionButtons.tooltip: Bed-Confinement and Crisis Benefit (11 specified conditions, regardless of waiting period).

optionButtons.label: Split Waiting Period
optionButtons.tooltip: Splits the total monthly benefit into two sums insured each with a different waiting period.

displays.label: Total Yearly Premium
displays.tooltip: This is the total premium the clients will pay for the year. For example, the monthly premium x 12 or the half-yearly premium x 2

Answer all questions accurately; proactively disclose even if not asked

quoteForm.sumInsuredEntry: Use 10x Backspace to clear calc-mask field, then type digits one at a time
quoteForm.coverButtonActivation: Must use eval button.click() — standard Playwright click does not trigger OutSystems XHR
quoteForm.saveMethod: Tab out of any Sum Insured field to trigger auto-save (no modal required)
quoteForm.dynamicIds: OutSystems regenerates element IDs per session; use attribute selectors like input[id*=SumInsured]
quoteForm.newQuoteNavigation: Patch window.open before clicking New Quote link; nav happens in-page
quoteForm.occupationSearch: Uses React Select — type search text then click dropdown option

applyFlow.textInputBinding: Standard fill() does NOT trigger OutSystems reactive binding in the apply flow. Use the 'type' action in server.js (clicks field, clears with Ctrl+A+Delete, types with 40ms delay, Tab blur).
applyFlow.checkboxInteraction: label.click() via eval does NOT register with OutSystems. Pattern: el.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) → getBoundingClientRect() → mouse-click at viewport coordinates
applyFlow.radioButtonInteraction: Same pattern as checkbox — scrollIntoView + mouse-click required for all radio inputs
applyFlow.buttonGroupInteraction: button-group-item elements. Selected state has class button-group-selected-item. Use scrollIntoView + mouse-click pattern.
applyFlow.offScreenElements: Elements with y > viewport height or y < 0 must be scrolled into view: el.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) → re-query getBoundingClientRect() → mouse-click
applyFlow.selectWithComplexIds: page.selectOption() may fail with long hyphenated IDs. Use eval: document.getElementById('...').value = '...'; document.getElementById('...').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'))
applyFlow.personalStatementCompletion: All 7 pages must be answered. Unanswered questions surfaced at UnderwritingSummary?l=1. Each Answer button navigates to specific page.
applyFlow.paymentCreditCard: QuickStream cross-domain iframe — cannot be automated with Playwright
applyFlow.paymentDirectDebit: Requires real valid NZ bank account. Backend modulus check validates bank/branch/account combination.
applyFlow.policyOwnerAdd: Selecting from owner dropdown does NOT add the owner. The Add button must be explicitly clicked.
applyFlow.adviserModals: Adviser Use popups and separate block modals must have OK or Apply button pressed before proceeding on main screen. Check for [role='dialog'] modals after every navigation.
